Name: Novan's Seasonal Grass Path 1.5 Fixed (Now Including WINTER Grass Path)
Author: Sigrah
Description:
Preface: I am not a mod author, and I don't know the first thing about how these mods are created and programmed. But, using Notepad++ and going through the three different versions of this mod here on NexusMods, I was able to piece together a fix / workaround so that the winter grass tiles would show correctly in-game during the Winter season while using this mod, instead of defaulting to the vanilla gravel path that serves as this mod's base template. In short, I basically brute-forced it.

Additionally, I AM NOT THE ORIGINAL CREATOR OF THIS MOD, NOR AM I THE ORIGINAL UPDATERS OF THE PREVIOUS FIXES FOR THIS MOD. Please do not send me money, donations, credit, or anything else related to this mod or its previous fixed versions. Like I said, I basically just copied the line of code from one fix to another fix, and you use this mod AT YOUR OWN RISK.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Known Issue(s): There was only one issue I came across while testing this mod. While using the mod *CJB Cheats Menu* to change the current season in-game, the grass graphics did not update to the correct grass for that season right away. For example, when changing the season from Fall to Spring in the cheat menu, the grass still looked like the Fall version of the grass instead of the Spring version. However, when my character went to bed in-game, this issue corrected itself, and appeared to be the proper grass color for Spring after starting the next day.

Beyond that, I did not come across any other bugs or issues with other mods that I use, but that's not to say they don't exist with a particular mod or game setting out there. Unfortunately, if you come across this issue, I will not be able to help you. Like I said in the preface, I'm not a modder or programmer, and I wouldn't know where to begin to search for the problem, let alone fix it. But, I'll try to monitor the messages for this mod, so if you come across an issue with a specific mod, feel free to post the name of the mod and the issue, and I'll add it to this list. And, if someone coming across this mod is a modder and / or programmer and thinks they can fix the problem(s), you're more than welcome to, I'm not the person for the job.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Conclusion: I am using this mod in all my current games, and I hope it will work for all of you out there that still enjoy playing this game, either currently or from time to time. If there is ever another update to this game from Concerned Ape, though, I won't know how to update it to work with any changes that might break this mod or cause it to have conflicts with the game itself or other updated mods. So, enjoy it while it lasts (hopefully forever unless someone comes along and can update it should that happen).

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
